G-Mode Archives+: Stella Deus - The Age of Alchemy

Also know as - Stella Deus: Alchemy Time is a spinoff of the Atlus tactics style game "Stella Deus: the Gate of Eternity" released on PS2. It is one of 2 Spinoff games, the other being: "Stella Deus: The Spirit of Darkness/The Black Spirit."
The Spirit of Darkness serving as the first game, and The Age of Alchemy serving as the second game.

The game was released on Japanese mobile phones on January 22nd, 2007 and recently on Steam & Nintendo Switch 1&2 thanks to G-Mode+ Archives. Releasing on the Switch Platforms on November 20th, 2025 & Steam on December 4th, 2025.

The game has Japanese text only.
